why: Learning experience design is an emergent instructional-design perspective and set of design commitments, not a general explanatory theory of how people learn, nor a specific implementation or research method.
Learning experience design is a learner-centered course-design framework applied here to one blended elementary mathematics course, not a general explanatory learning theory.
This is a single high-school Physics implementation for teaching Special Theory of Relativity, not a domain-general reusable pattern.
This is a study-specific immersive-VR and inquiry-based Physics learning design for teaching Special Theory of Relativity, not a general explanatory learning theory.
